description: Compose the incident work order for an exact node id (a service, file, or symbol): the recorded incident, likely cause chain, blast radius, governing policies, and divergences, each claim provenance-tagged — the same card NEAT pushes when it detects a failure. Have a symptom or a bare service name instead of a node id? Call investigate; it resolves the name and composes this card. Omit errorId for the latest incident or pin a specific one, then use expand/relate to verify the path.

errorId.description: Pin a specific incident by its id; omit for the most recent

nodeId.description: Graph node id the incident is on (service/file/symbol)

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

name: get_incident_card
